cause_verified: Chrome remote-debugging-pipe fails when USERPROFILE points to synthetic isolated directory on this Windows host.

observations.USERPROFILE_only: CDP timeout; stderr says non-default data directory required despite explicit temporary --user-data-dir

probe: Existing Archify ChromeVisualBrowser with explicit private profile; 5-second diagnostic startup limit, not an increased production timeout.
proposed_fix: For isolated real-browser test subprocess only, omit synthetic USERPROFILE; keep HOME, config roots, APPDATA, LOCALAPPDATA and explicit temporary browser --user-data-dir. No user-profile browser access, no sandbox flags or permission changes.
